characters.name: The groomer
characters.description: Dark hair in a loose high bun, black T-shirt, forest-green waterproof apron and black work shoes.
characters.rule: She stands outside the tub. Left hand steadies the dog; right hand washes or rinses. Both hands stay with the dog when the phone rings.
characters.prompt: Photorealistic film-production character reference sheet. Clean warm-white background, fine gray panel rules, small dark forest sans-serif section headings, clear readable short labels, generous but efficient spacing. Dense professionally organized multi-section board like a comprehensive casting bible, NOT a moodboard or a cinematic scene collage. Real skin, natural proportions, subtle studio lighting, consistent same individual in every panel. No logos, watermarks or promotional copy. Layout: large hero headshot upper left; FIVE full-body turnaround views across upper right (front, three-quarter, profile, three-quarter back, back) same outfit and scale; EIGHT facial expressions middle row (neutral, warm smile, focused, listening, curious, amused, mildly concerned, relieved); SIX task-specific full-body pose studies lower middle; SIX detail closeups along bottom (face, hair, hands, fabric, footwear, signature prop) plus five small labeled palette swatches. Include all sections at a readable size. Keep anatomy and identity stable; no impossible extra hands. Title HAPPY PAWS — THE GROOMER. Use ONLY the adult female groomer in the reference's upper panels for identity, not the caller or mascot. Same dark brown loose high bun, soft fringe, light olive skin, brown eyes, natural face, late30s, practical athletic build. Black crew-neck short-sleeve T-shirt, forest-green waterproof bib apron to knees tied at waist, black trousers, black nonslip lace-up shoes; no jewelry. Apron neck strap, same bun and outfit across every view. SIX poses: relaxed standing; feet planted and bending slightly forward with both arms reaching waist-height; left hand gently supporting dog's chest and right hand shampooing shoulder; glancing toward ringing phone while hands stay working; right hand holding rinse nozzle directed downward; soft satisfied smile after task. For any washing pose, include ONLY part of white Samoyed inside stainless waist-height tub and show woman's legs fully OUTSIDE tub on floor. No bathtub with human inside. Detail prop black rinse nozzle. No mascot, no caller in this sheet.

characters.name: The Samoyed

characters.rule: This is the dog already being washed. Its shoulder goes from shampooed to rinsed; its face stays dry. It never appears at the caller’s home.

characters.name: Milo the Yorkie
characters.description: Tiny tan-and-steel Yorkie with upright ears and long, comically flyaway facial hair.
characters.rule: Milo is dry and playful at home. Keep the same flyaway coat throughout the call. He is not the white dog in the tub.
characters.prompt: Photorealistic film-production character reference sheet. Clean warm-white background, fine gray panel rules, small dark forest sans-serif section headings, clear readable short labels, generous but efficient spacing. Dense professionally organized multi-section board like a comprehensive casting bible, NOT a moodboard or a cinematic scene collage. Real skin, natural proportions, subtle studio lighting, consistent same individual in every panel. No logos, watermarks or promotional copy. Title HAPPY PAWS — MILO THE YORKIE. Create one consistent photorealistic small adult Yorkshire terrier character. Toy-sized 3kg, fine tan face hair and legs, subtle dark steel-gray saddle on back, pointed upright ears with pink inner skin, dark glossy eyes, little black nose, long wispy golden facial fur and crest sticking out unevenly like static flyaways. Funny overgrown hair but healthy, comfortable and very endearing, NOT a monster. Natural small canine body, no clothes or human anatomy, no collar needed. Broad comprehensive sheet: large hero portrait; EIGHT fullbody rotation views front/frontleft/left/backleft/back/backright/right/frontright; EIGHT expression head studies curious, tiny tongue out, head tilt left, head tilt right, alert, relaxed pant, sleepy blink, innocent look; SIX pose studies seated sofa-height, standing, nosing a loose cotton sock, one paw gently resting on owner's forearm (arm only as context), curled resting, looking up toward owner; SIX detail crops flyaway tan fur/steel saddle/eyes/nose/upright ears/small paws; THREE coat studies front side back showing identical DRY overgrown coat, never suddenly groomed. Palette tan, honey, steel gray, nose black, warm pink tongue. Consistent same Yorkie not Samoyed, no white fluffy breed, no snarling/teeth/distress or exaggerated electrified lightning.
